resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password and recover account access?
resetPassword.answer: Use Forgot Password from the login page. You will receive a reset email with instructions to create a new password and sign in again.

editProfile.question: How do I edit my profile information?
editProfile.answer: Go to Settings > Account, click Edit Profile, update first name, last name, email, phone, or bio, then save.

changeProfilePicture.question: How do I change my profile picture?
changeProfilePicture.answer: In Settings > Account, click Edit Profile, choose Change Photo, select an image (JPG/PNG/WEBP up to 5MB), and save.

manageUsers.question: How do I add or update user accounts?
manageUsers.answer: Open Users to create, edit, or deactivate user accounts. Assign roles carefully so each user has the right access level.

createProperty.question: How do I create a new property and submit it for review?
createProperty.answer: Go to Property > Add, complete required details, and save as draft or submit for review depending on your permissions.

createValuation.question: How do I create a property valuation report?
createValuation.answer: Go to Property Valuation > Add, select a property, complete valuation fields, upload supporting files, and submit when ready.

googleMap.question: How do I use Google Map in the system?
googleMap.answer: Open Google Map to search mapped properties, apply filters, and click markers to inspect property details linked to the map.

workflow.question: What is the approval workflow status order?
workflow.answer: Typical workflow is Draft -> Pending Review -> Approved or Rejected. Final actions depend on role permissions and hierarchy level.

contactSupport.question: How can I contact support directly?
contactSupport.answer: Contact support by email at {email} or Telegram chat at {telegram}.
